description:
Natural home remedies, natural pest control, and cheap DIY home
repair that actually work. Hank Walker spent 30 years as a
contractor — now he tests the natural fix before anyone sells you
an expensive repair or a jug of chemicals.

Organic pest control for your house and yard. How to get rid of
bed bugs, roaches, mice, mosquitoes, ants and weeds using baking
soda, vinegar, and simple ingredients you already have. Safe for
kids. Safe for pets. Usually under five dollars.

Every episode: the real problem, the honest danger, and the
natural remedy Hank uses himself — exact ratios, real results,
no hype.

Natural home remedies · natural pest control · organic pest
control · DIY home repair · home maintenance tips · non-toxic
cleaning · chemical-free home · homesteading tips

New videos every week. Got a problem in your house? Drop it in
the comments — Hank might build an episode around it.
